ProvaLivre

A different, fair exam for every student — in one click.

Anti-cheating exam generation for underfunded public schools

Carine Zambrano  ·  MGT 409

The problem

My uncle Erick teaches civil engineering at an underfunded public high school in Brazil.

  • Students copy each other during exams — “filar”
  • The same exam gets reused → answers passed down across terms
  • Hand-making a unique exam per student is impossible by hand

“Each student's exam should pull random questions — same difficulty, different exam — so they can't copy.”

What's new

ToolGap for Erick
Canvas / Google ClassroomNo exam generation
Google Forms / QuizizzShuffle order only — same questions & numbers
ChatGPTNo bank, no guaranteed-correct math, no per-student assembly

ProvaLivre: per-student unique exams with numeric variants whose answers are computed by code, built from the teacher's own material — plus a human gate on AI math.

How the agents work

AI writes the questions once; Python computes the math; a free, deterministic assembler builds every student's exam.

Demo: 30 students, 30 unique exams
